mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as saeContractorName, c2.C_Name as saeSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as saeCostConsultName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Type as conType, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Inv_Settlement_End mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Sae_Contractor = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Sae_Supervisor = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Sae_Cost_Consult = c3.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.Con_Id = #{conId} and mn.State = 7 order by mn.State_Time desc limit 1

select c1.C_Name as saeContractorName, c2.C_Name as saeSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as saeCostConsultName, con.con_Name as conName, con.con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.con_Type as conType, con.con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Project_Stage as pProjectStage, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Inv_Settlement_End mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Sae_Contractor = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Sae_Supervisor = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Sae_Cost_Consult = c3.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.Sae_Id = #{saId}

select c1.C_Name as saeContractorName, c2.C_Name as saeSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as saeCostConsultName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Type as conType, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Con_Pay pay left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = pay.Con_Id left join Inv_Settlement_End mn on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Sae_Contractor = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Sae_Supervisor = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Sae_Cost_Consult = c3.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where pay.Pay_Id = #{payId} order by pay.Pay_State_Time desc limit 1
